description: Verify that the student's Nano 33 BLE Sense generates a free-running 1 kHz, 25% duty cycle square wave on D5 immediately after reset, without any stimulus.

steps.requirement: The signal on D5 has a frequency of 1 kHz and a duty cycle of 25%, starting on its own right after reset.

not_graded.requirement: Must use a hardware timer/PWM peripheral (not analogWrite() or delay()-based bit-banging).
not_graded.reason: Not electrically observable: a correctly timed 1 kHz/25% waveform can be produced by either a hardware timer or careful software timing; this can only be checked by TA code review.

not_graded.requirement: Register values/constants are commented and their computation explained.
not_graded.reason: Code documentation/comments cannot be verified electrically; requires manual review of the submitted source.

assumptions: No tolerance was given for frequency, so a default of tol_pct: 2 is used.
No tolerance was given for duty cycle, so a default of tol_abs: 1 percentage point is used.
A 500 ms measurement window is used, giving ~500 periods of the 1 kHz signal for a stable frequency/duty measurement.
Requirement 2 (signal starts on its own after reset) is verified implicitly by measuring the waveform right after the mandatory 1000 ms boot wait, with no stimulus step preceding it.
